The shared-source protection helper returned a vacuous PASS when both inputs were the same tree: each protected non-models file was compared with itself. This proposal compares those ten paths to immutable canonical Git blobs and rejects missing objects/paths and Git replacement refs. The two approved models states/mixed directions, production sources, formulas and result fingerprints remain unchanged.

Source checkpoint: `fc6720bdc8143e97bf25e37e4091b1f2aa54b69f` on `codex/integration-hardening-2026-10-03`; base/merge-base is preserved PR31 `675d0d298fbaab5b8473ed048a561ef84e2f3e78`. Four history-preserving commits/merges, fourteen additive scoped evidence files and two owned helper/test modifications; production source changes 0. This is a Draft stacked proposal, not canonical integration.

Validation completed:

- Targeted 9→27 PASS; 18 new negative/control test cases. Ten previously undetected tampered paths now all fail. Independent probes 21/21 expected outcomes.
- Actual local exact-fc full suite: 1,295 PASS, zero failures/errors/skips. Existing 1,277 cases reconfirmed.
- Seven final GitHub workflows SUCCESS, each actually runs 1,295 tests. Native [37109899437](https://github.com/kco994553-star/Investment-System1/actions/runs/37109899437) checks out exactfc and also passes six producer-Web withheld-contract E2E groups. Its separate Macro job checks out exact `4a07099e36ec3cecda24b82ecedad53800f0aa81`, 11 PASS.
- Six inherited workflows check out distinct synthetic PR merge `d7c9908c827cac1a53e5b1654e0a7502ee10b34d`, with tree `e236e62a6ff8b0a151710c5e7a77068d08ab0256` identical to exactfc. Commit equality is not claimed. Legacy Web workflow NOT_TRIGGERED by this scope.
- All 215 production source files and scoped Frozen/v1/approval records preserved. Numerical fingerprint bytes match SHA256 `f690f9c08b6b2692af5c0c1cdfc957c768ffa13841406f837f4f899518320866`.
- Native/Macro artifact ZIP hashes match GitHub: `d7f5e980a8a92a82076f09532de9133fa3b800384958c4daebbb14b1dcd34cd9` / `525d4860fa54e09d091ccb45083bcc25b7613ddb1f75b3b9c464eafb3be34cdb`.

Completed bounded F1 work is HANDOFF_READY for independent Primary Integration Writer review. Parent capability maturity stays SYNTHETIC_VERIFIED, Δ0; canonical remains b8e39a2. Real CAL_VERIFY access, Holdout consumption, numeric-policy choices, publication grants, Official promotions and canonical merges all +0. Active M-v2 remains pending its separate arithmetic decision. External active Web owner branches remain read-only; G3 is not claimed resolved by this helper fix.
